target: Close the two embedded-audit control gaps that sit outside TP-DMX-EMBEDDED-AUDIT-VALIDATOR-SCOPE-PARITY-001: a local signing wrapper that can report success without producing a signature (VSH-001), and a changed-contract preflight that strips the canonical report_path pattern for proof/pr_merge/** and can therefore false-green a malformed proof (VSH-002). Both must end fail-closed, with success determined by deterministic evidence rather than by a process printing a success line.
invariants: SCOPE IS EXACTLY TWO DEFECTS: VSH-001 (scripts/audit/sign_local_audit_proof.sh false success) and VSH-002 (scripts/governance/validate_change_contract.py report_path pattern loss for proof/pr_merge/**). Nothing else. Sweep scope and pre-commit scope belong to TP-DMX-EMBEDDED-AUDIT-VALIDATOR-SCOPE-PARITY-001 and must not be pulled in here.

PACKET 001 DOES NOT AUTHORIZE THIS WORK: TP-DMX-EMBEDDED-AUDIT-VALIDATOR-SCOPE-PARITY-001 names scripts/governance/validate_change_contract.py only inside its commit.verify list. A verification dependency is not a mutation allowlist. This packet exists so neither defect is repaired under borrowed authority.

BOTH DEFECTS ARE CONFIRMED, NOT HYPOTHESISED: VSH-001 was observed live during the PR #1165 round-4 signing — with a stale .sig present, ssh-keygen prompts before overwrite, EOF declines the prompt, the previous signature survives untouched, and the wrapper still prints 'signed: <path>.sig'. VSH-002 is present on trusted main at 5d694cc9898e5046b5da03319f20f48599c40ca8, scripts/governance/validate_change_contract.py lines 245-251, and was raised independently as review thread #8 on PR #1165.

PRE-EXISTING, NOT INTRODUCED BY PR #1165: VSH-002 predates PR #1165 and that PR does not modify the file. PR #1165 is frozen at SIGNED_PROOF_HEAD 3a6cc60d53ad6f6cc60d562247502670125493cc and must not be reopened, re-signed, or widened for either defect. Do not describe VSH-002 as a regression introduced by the embedded-audit repair series.

STALE JUSTIFYING COMMENT: the VSH-002 softening is justified in-code by the comment 'Local acceptance intentionally skips report_path for pr_merge'. That statement is FALSE as of TP-DMX-AUDIT-AGY-GEMINI31-APPROVAL-001-REPAIR-001, which removed the report_path exemption from scripts/audit/local_audit_acceptance.py. The repair must remove or correct the comment along with the branch, so a future reader does not restore the exemption on an obsolete rationale.

SUCCESS MUST BE EVIDENCE-BOUND: a wrapper that wrote no signature must not exit 0, and a preflight that validated nothing must not report PASS. Process stdout is never accepted as evidence that an artifact was produced or verified.

DIRECT SIGNER INVOCATION IS NOT PRECEDENT: the PR #1165 round-4 signature was produced by calling ssh-keygen -Y sign directly after relocating the stale .sig, and verified independently. That was an accepted one-round measure, not standing authority to bypass the wrapper. This packet must make the wrapper itself trustworthy so the bypass is unnecessary.

NO GATE WEAKENING: this packet must not weaken signature verification, allowed-signers trust, namespace binding, repository or PR identity, audited-head ancestry, proof-only successor closure, passing-verdict policy, the embedded_audit.required=true acceptance policy, or PR Steward semantics. Repairs may only make gates stricter or more honest.

SCHEMA VALIDITY AND ACCEPTANCE POLICY REMAIN DISTINCT: schemas/proof/embedded_audit.schema.json is the only authority on embedded_audit shape and is deliberately more permissive than acceptance, because it also describes CI-emitted diagnostic proofs. Gates the schema cannot express live in local_audit_acceptance.policy_errors() and are pinned by POLICY_ONLY_REJECTIONS. Do not introduce a second hand-written structural validator, and do not migrate a policy gate into the schema to make the routes look consistent.

BOUNDED BLAST RADIUS: removing the VSH-002 softening may surface pre-existing nonconformant proofs under proof/pr_merge/**. Enumerate and classify them before changing behaviour. Turning CI red across unrelated history is a failed execution of this packet, not a success. A legacy proof that genuinely cannot conform must become an enumerated, reviewed exemption entry — never a restored pattern-stripping branch.

INVESTIGATE BEFORE MUTATING: S01 and S03 are read-only investigation steps that must complete and record findings before the corresponding repair step runs. Neither repair may be authored from this packet's description alone; both must be authored from inspected source.

pr.title: fix(audit): fail-closed local signing wrapper and canonical report_path in changed-contract preflight
pr.body: Closes the two embedded-audit control gaps separated from PR #1165: a signing wrapper that can print success without writing a signature (VSH-001), and a changed-contract preflight that strips the canonical report_path pattern for proof/pr_merge/** (VSH-002). Both defects are confirmed rather than hypothesised, both are pre-existing, and neither is repairable under TP-DMX-EMBEDDED-AUDIT-VALIDATOR-SCOPE-PARITY-001, which names one of the files only as a verification command.

steps.task: VSH-001 investigation: establish exactly how the signing wrapper can report success without producing a new signature. Read-only.
requirements: Inspect scripts/audit/sign_local_audit_proof.sh and record the exact control flow from preflight through ssh-keygen invocation to the success line, including the effect of set -euo pipefail on the observed path.
Determine why ssh-keygen's overwrite prompt receiving EOF does not produce a non-zero exit that set -e would catch, and record the observed exit status rather than assuming one.
Enumerate every caller of the wrapper (CI workflows, docs, runbooks, packets) so the repair's blast radius is known before changing its contract.
Produce a deterministic reproducer: a stale .sig present, PROOF.json bytes changed, signer invoked with stdin at EOF, wrapper prints success, and the .sig content hash is unchanged.

Record whether any published proof in the repository currently carries a signature over bytes other than its own PROOF.json — this establishes whether the defect has already caused a false attestation or only could have.
Do not modify the wrapper in this step.

steps.task: VSH-001 repair: make the signing wrapper fail closed so success depends on deterministic evidence rather than stdout.
requirements: Ensure a pre-existing .sig cannot be silently retained: remove or quarantine it before invoking the signer, or invoke ssh-keygen in a mode that cannot stop at an interactive overwrite prompt. The chosen mechanism must be justified against the S01 findings.
Require the signer's exit status to be 0 and require the expected signature object to exist afterwards.
Prove the signature was newly produced rather than stale-reused, by comparing the signature content hash captured before and after signing.

Independently execute ssh-keygen -Y verify over the exact PROOF.json bytes against config/audit/embedded-audit-allowed-signers, binding both the expected principal and the namespace, and require exit 0.
Fail closed on any missing, unreadable, or contradictory evidence — including a verify pass whose principal or namespace does not match the expected values.
Print the success line only after every check above has passed, never before, and never on a path where no signature was written.
Preserve the existing proof-shape preflight; this repair adds evidence checks and must not remove an existing one.

steps.task: VSH-002 investigation: establish the authoritative schema, the transformation path, the exact field loss, and the current callers. Read-only.
requirements: Identify the authoritative schema the preflight loads and confirm it is schemas/proof/embedded_audit.schema.json rather than a copy or a derived structure.

Record the exact transformation path: where the schema object is copied, which property is rewritten, and which keyword is removed — as of 5d694cc9898e5046b5da03319f20f48599c40ca8 this is the report_path.pattern pop at lines 245-251, guarded on paths beginning with proof/pr_merge/.
State the exact field loss and its consequence: with the pattern removed, report_path degrades to an unconstrained string, so a value violating the canonical single-directory pattern validates clean.
Enumerate current callers of validate_change_contract.py — workflows, hooks, local runbooks — and state which gates consume its result, so it is known what the false green currently unblocks.

Produce a false-pass reproducer: a proof under proof/pr_merge/ whose report_path violates the canonical pattern, accepted by the preflight and rejected by a direct scripts/audit/validate_audit_proof.py run.
Enumerate every existing proof under proof/pr_merge/** that would newly fail once the pattern is enforced, and classify each as REPAIR, QUARANTINE, or DOCUMENTED-LEGACY with a stated reason.
Do not modify the preflight in this step.

steps.task: VSH-002 repair: validate the unmodified canonical schema in the changed-contract preflight.
requirements: Remove the branch that copies the trusted schema and pops report_path.pattern for paths under proof/pr_merge/, so the preflight validates the canonical schema unmodified.
Remove or correct the obsolete justifying comment 'Local acceptance intentionally skips report_path for pr_merge', which no longer describes local acceptance behaviour.
Handle every bundle identified in S03 under its recorded classification. Do not restore the exemption, and do not add a compensating softening elsewhere.
Any retained exemption must be an explicit enumerated entry naming the specific path and the reason, reviewable in the diff — never a pattern-stripping branch or a silent fallthrough.
Confirm the preflight still fails closed when jsonschema is unavailable rather than degrading to a partial check.

steps.task: Pin both repairs with regression tests that fail if either control silently reverts.
requirements: Assert the signing wrapper exits non-zero when a stale .sig is present and no new signature is written — the exact S01 reproducer, inverted.
Assert the wrapper exits non-zero when ssh-keygen -Y verify fails, when the principal does not match, and when the namespace does not match.
Assert the changed-contract preflight rejects a proof under proof/pr_merge/ whose report_path violates the canonical pattern — the exact case the softening admitted.

Assert the preflight validates proof/pr_merge/ paths against the same schema object as non-pr_merge paths, so a future reader cannot reintroduce a path-conditional schema mutation without failing a test.

Record in docs/ops/embedded-audit-proof.md that wrapper stdout is not evidence of signing, that ssh-keygen -Y verify over the committed bytes is the controlling check, and which routes validate which paths.
State the historical false-green plainly in the docs rather than describing the repaired state as though it had always held.
